pattern: keep a backgrounded thread from being load-paused by setting its priority to normal
experience: Backgrounded threads default to low priority, so load management may pause them. Asked to keep one running in the background, the agent must set its priority to normal, not bring it to the foreground.
rule: t3_thread_organize: Load management pauses only low-priority threads, and backgrounded ones default to low: `set_priority` takes `priority`.
